label: Existing concrete supporters at the selected world of NECESSARY_2 concreta are NECESSARY_2
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: every concrete candidate that exists at the selected world w and stands, at w, in the selected relation to a concrete candidate existing at every world accessible from w itself exists at every world accessible from w. Supporters existing only at other worlds, and support edges at other worlds, are not constrained. The selected-world instance of STMT-NO-CONTINGENT-CONCRETE-SUPPORT, which constrains supporters and edges at every carrier world; it is the existing selected-world condition STMT-ACTUAL-NO-CONTINGENT instantiated on the concrete subtype.
